quests.name: A Gloomy Goofy Adventure
objectives: Follow Eeyore to the waterfall near the entrance of the Gloommeadow .
Follow the footprints to retrace Goofy's steps and find the lost present.
Talk to Eeyore about the footprints.
Keep on following the footprints.
Wait, weren't you here before? Talk to Eeyore .
Follow the new set of footprints leading through Drowsybloom Acre .
Pick up Goofy's Present .
Make sure you have the Eeyore Tablecloth in your Inventory.
Bring the Eeyore Tablecloth to Goofy (so he can give it to Eeyore himself).
Go visit Winnie the Pooh in his House.
Talk to Winnie the Pooh and re-introduce him to Goofy .

Collect the materials for Goofy :
  ‧ Fish for Driftwood. (4) Gather Oak Leaves. (3) Pick White & Pink Foxglove. (2)
Bring the materials to Goofy .
Use the recipe in your Inventory.

Gather Ingredients to feed everyone:
  ‧ Gather Golden Honey. (3) Pick Purple Thistle. (2) Catch Plush Fish. (1) Grow any vegetable. (1)
Cook a Honey-Glazed Plush Fish for Goofy .

Make sure you have the following in your Inventory:
  ‧ Honey-Glazed Plush Fish. (1) Golden Honey. (2) Purple Thistle. (2)
Bring the food to Eeyore .
Place the Eeyore Picnic Set in the Honeyglow Woods .
Take a picture of friends enjoying a picnic.
Talk to Eeyore about how his reunion with Goofy went.

quests.name: Tails and Tribulations
objectives: Enter the Everoak Tree via the Gloommeadow .

Eeyore's tail isn't here. Take photos of any evidence you find instead:
  ‧ Odd Footprints. Pile of Junk.
Talk to Eeyore about the evidence you gathered.
Listen to Eeyore and Piglet have a conversation about the missing tail.
Clean up Eeyore's napping spot by entering the Everoak Tree from the Gloommeadow . (5)

A clue appeared! Pick it up:
  ‧ Blue Fur.
Make sure you have the Blue Fur in your Inventory.
Bring the Blue Fur to Eeyore .
Question Stitch about Eeyore's missing tail.
Visit Winnie the Pooh at his House to ask about Stitch's sandwich.
Oh no, Winnie the Pooh is about to eat Stitch's sandwich! Stop him.
Cook a meal with Golden Honey for Winnie the Pooh .
Make sure you have the Golden Honey meal in your Inventory.
Bring the Golden Honey meal to Winnie the Pooh .
Make sure you have Stitch's Sandwich in your Inventory.
Return Stitch's Sandwich to him.

Catch the tail-swiping hedgehog in the Gloommeadow .
  ‧ (He's a different color from the rest.)
Make sure you have the Worn-Out Tail in your Inventory.
Give the Worn-Out Tail back to Eeyore .
Talk to Winnie the Pooh for tail-related advice.

Gather materials to repair Eeyore's Worn-Out Tail :
  ‧ Have the Worn-Out Tail. (1) Craft Fiber by refining Seaweed. (10) Gather Tree Resin. (5) Mine for Soft Limestone. (2) Fish for Sweet Jelly. (3)
Repair the Worn-Out Tail at a Crafting Station.
Talk to Stitch about Eeyore's tail.

Make sure you have the items in your Inventory:
  ‧ Repaired Tail. Alien Glue.
Bring the Repaired Tail and Alien Glue to Eeyore .
Dress up with Eeyore's Tail .
Test your tails by running with Stitch in Drowsybloom Acre .
Run with Stitch to the Gloommeadow .
Talk to Eeyore to confirm your tails are secure.

quests.name: The Shy Villagers Society
objectives: Enter the Everoak Tree from the Gloommeadow to think about Eeyore's request.
Sadness is here too. Talk to her.

Play Pooh Sticks with Eeyore and Sadness .
  ‧ Interact with the bridge in the Gloommeadow to play.
Ask Eeyore what he thinks of hanging out with Sadness .

Gather the materials to craft a "Do Not Disturb" Sign and some Comfy Pillows :
  ‧ Gather Hardwood. (6) Mine for Honey Agate. (2) Dig for Soil. (16) Gather Oak Leaves. (8) Pick Yellow & Orange Foxglove. (4)

Craft the requested furniture at a Crafting Station:
  ‧ "Do Not Disturb" Sign. (1) Comfy Pillow. (4)

Make sure you have the furniture for Eeyore .
  ‧ Comfy Pillow. (4)
Bring the furniture to Eeyore .

Place the "Do Not Disturb" Sign near the entrance of the Everoak Tree in the Gloommeadow .
  ‧ "Do Not Disturb" Sign.
Enter the Everoak Tree from the Gloommeadow .
Listen to Winnie the Pooh and Alice .
Listen to Eeyore and Sadness .
This meeting isn't quite working out. Talk with Eeyore .

Use the recipes in your Inventory:
  ‧ Honey Macarons. Honey Triffle.

Cook tea party snacks :
  ‧ Cook a Honey Triffle. Cook Honey Macarons.

Make sure you have the tea party snacks and the materials for the earmuffs in your Inventory.
  ‧ Honey Triffle. (1) Honey Macarons. (1) Rich Soil. (5) Purple Thistle. (2) Rope. (10)
Bring the tea party snacks and the materials for the earmuffs to Sadness .

Dress up with:
  ‧ Purple Fuzzy Earmuffs. (1) (Optional) Casual Clothing. (2)
Listen in on the members of the Shy Villagers Society.
Check in with Eeyore to see how they're feeling now.
Take a picture to commemorate the first meeting of the Shy Villagers Society.
Chat with Eeyore about the Shy Villagers Society.

quests.name: Eeyore's Lost and Found
objectives:
Gather materials to craft a Lost-and-Found Kiosk :
  ‧ Gather Hardwood. (10) Fish for Driftwood. (6) Gather Oak Leaves. (5) Mine for Honey Agate. (3)
Craft the Lost-and-Found Kiosk .
Place the Lost-and-Found Kiosk near the Gloommeadow bridge.
Talk to Eeyore about the Lost-and-Found Kiosk .
Check on the Lost-and-Found Kiosk .
Our first lost-and-found item has arrived! Pick it up.
A Lost Scarf ? See if Eeyore knows who might have lost this.
Make sure you have the Lost Scarf in your Inventory.
Bring the Lost Scarf to Piglet .
Check on the Lost-and-Found Kiosk .
How did a Lost Snowflake get in there? Catch it!
Ask Eeyore who might have lost this Lost Snowflake .
Make sure you have the Lost Snowflake in your Inventory.
Bring the Lost Snowflake to Olaf .
Check on the Lost-and-Found Kiosk .
A Lost Note ? How mysterious. Pick it up.
Ask Eeyore if he knows who the Lost Note belongs to.
Talk to Winnie the Pooh about the note he wrote.

Dress up for exercise in:
  ‧ Sporty Clothing. (2)
Work out with Winnie the Pooh and Eeyore .
Check on the Lost-and-Found Kiosk .
Let Eeyore know there's nothing left at the kiosk.
Place the Iced Tea Stand in the Honeyglow Woods .
Take a picture of friends enjoying the Iced Tea Stand .
Talk to Eeyore about his lost-and-found adventure.
rewards: Eeyore Iced Tea Stand Lemon Crate
